trust_decision.summary: Whether untrusted S3 request-body XML may declare a DTD / resolve external entities; decided solely by the properties set on the Woodstox XMLInputFactory handed to the two XmlMapper instances (explicit factory bypasses Jackson's own XXE-safe defaults, which apply only when no factory is passed).

landing_point.why: Summary says 'Bucket Operations'; an engineer searches for readValue in bucket handlers, then follows serviceFactory.getInstance(XmlMapper.class) to LocalS3.java:123.

fix_sites.entry_point: Shared XmlMapper registered in ServiceFactory (LocalS3.java:129), consumed by 7 HTTP handlers: CreateBucket, PutBucketAcl, PutBucketTagging, PutBucketVersioning, DeleteObjects, CompleteMultipartUpload, PutObjectTagging
public static XmlUtils.fromXml(String, Class) (XmlUtils.java:37-39); no main-code caller, used only in tests
fix_sites.module_kind: utility class, lower-level public API (second mapper instance)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: local-s3-rest/src/main/java/com/robothy/s3/rest/utils/XmlUtils.java:37-39 (static mapper built at XmlUtils.java:17-24; all main-code callers use only toXml, e.g. local-s3-rest/src/main/java/com/robothy/s3/rest/handler/NotFoundHandler.java:32)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: XmlUtils is only used to serialize error/ListParts responses in production code; fromXml has no main-code caller, so a solver can argue it never sees request input and leave its factory unhardened.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Mapper must stay namespace-unaware so ACL Grantee 'xmlns:xsi' / 'xsi:type' attributes and AWS-SDK bodies with xmlns still round-trip; an over-broad fix that swaps in a default (namespace-aware) XmlMapper or rejects any body containing '<!'/xmlns would break PutBucketAcl and SDK requests.

O6_input_shapes: plain request body via ByteBufInputStream (CreateBucketController.java:42, PutBucketAclController.java:47-48, PutBucketTaggingController.java:34, CompleteMultipartUploadController.java:45)
external general entity and DTD/parameter entity both blocked by SUPPORT_DTD=false + IS_SUPPORTING_EXTERNAL_ENTITIES=false (fix.diff:13-14)

O7_producer.where: local-s3-rest/src/main/java/com/robothy/s3/rest/LocalS3.java:123-129 (mapper built and registered in ServiceFactory; handlers fetch it, e.g. local-s3-rest/src/main/java/com/robothy/s3/rest/handler/CreateBucketController.java:33)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Handler builds its own namespace-aware Woodstox XmlFactory locally for ACL xsi:type parsing instead of using the shared mapper.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ACL is the one type with namespaced attributes (Grantee.java:25-29); a maintainer could special-case its parser, exactly as AccessControlPolicyTest.java:43-45 already does.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An XML metadata/ACL persistence reader in local-s3-core (save/reload of stored bucket ACL/tagging as XML) built with its own XMLInputFactory.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Core already has a parallel JSON loader for persisted state; storing S3 XML documents verbatim and re-parsing on load is a plausible design and sits in another module from the HTTP handlers.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Wire a real request handler (e.g. a not-yet-implemented PutBucketLifecycle/CORS) through XmlUtils.fromXml so the second mapper is reachable from HTTP.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Many S3 operations are routed to NotImplementedOperationController; a maintainer adding one would naturally reach for the static helper.

O10_build.toolchain: Gradle (wrapper, buildSrc), Jackson 2.18.1 + Woodstox, Netty 4.1.118, JUnit 5.11
O10_build.project_tests: Datatype XML round-trip tests (local-s3-datatypes/src/test/java/com/robothy/s3/datatypes/AccessControlPolicyTest.java), handler test local-s3-rest/src/test/java/com/robothy/s3/rest/handler/CopyObjectControllerTest.java, end-to-end SDK tests in local-s3-integrationtest; no XXE test at pinned commit and none added by the fix.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Disable DTD/external entities on the shared mapper in LocalS3.createServiceFactory only, leaving the XmlUtils static mapper unchanged.

out_of_scope_notes: PutBucketAclController.java:47-48 uses Optional.orElse (eager) so the body is always parsed even if a header ACL were present; functional quirk, not pursued.
unverified: repo_mb not measured. The project looks small (8 Gradle modules, one XML stack), so tiny_repo may well hold, but it is left out of O12 because the size was not checked.
